content_of_post_to_answer: What is one mistake that ruined your character?
answer: The mistake that damages character is often not the wrong action itself, but the story we build to justify it. A single compromise can become a habit when we stop seeing it as a warning and start seeing it as our identity. I have written more about this pattern on my profile for anyone interested in exploring how small choices reshape who we become. Character rarely collapses in one dramatic moment; it erodes when we repeatedly negotiate with the values we once refused to betray.
